confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on 2026-dated aggregate sources (a Numbeo-derived guide from February 2026, a Citizen Daily Post Poland and Krakow guide from July 2026, Expatistan from May 2026), plus undated Warsaw and Krakow bar data. No Zakopane-specific price data was found, so a resort premium over those cities is a judgement call. Cocktail and wine values lean on Warsaw listings and the local beer relationship, and the wine glass is the least supported drink anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates made without any accommodation search and are low-confidence. The FX value (0.6955 USD per AUD, 15 October 2026) came from search-result text attributed to the RBA; I did not open the RBA page to verify it. Local-currency prices were converted to USD at an approximate rate implied by the sources' own conversions.
comparable_city_reasoning: Aggregated Poland-wide and Krakow/Warsaw restaurant and bar prices, adjusted upward for Zakopane's tourist-resort pricing on the Krupowki area. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for July peak season in a Tatra resort town.
